1eg1yg1g.sourceDescription: Create a magical holiday ambiance in your house with this artificial half Christmas tree! Bushy Christmas tree: The Christmas tree is designed with a lot of beautiful PVC tips, which give the tree a beautiful realistic look along with a bushy appearance.Sturdy stand: The artificial Christmas tree is made of a sturdy steel stand, which provides the tree with optimal stability.Half-round design: Additionally, the half-round design makes it an eye-catching centrepiece of your Christmas decorations. It can be placed against the wall to save more space.Lasting durability: The Xmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Product Specifications Colour: Pink Material: PVC, steel Tree height: 240 cm Maximum tree width: 125 cm Base diameter: 50 cm With 1050 branches Half-round Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

k16t14jm.sourceDescription: Inject charm and character to your front door with this attractive pre-decorated Christmas wreath from Christmas Tree World! Please note: Majestic Dew Pine garland is not included. Our 60cm Majestic Dew Pine wreath uses the same realistic ‘bottle-brush’ PVC branch tips as our best-selling Majestic Dew Pine tree. Best of all, this pre-lit Christmas wreath comes with pre-attached LEDs so all you need to do is pop up and enjoy the magic – no stringing lights required!
